items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Al Casey on guitar was on that show

ctx.x: I don't know. I really couldn't tell you, but I know he's still alive, and from Henry Mills (inaudible) I told you the drummer that played with me (inaudible) in the postal service, still is in Detroit, said Al was doing fine (inaudible) before I got on it.
And, you know, naturally I'm quite interested in guys that have been my close friends. Yet we don't keep in close touch. I like to know how they're doing, you know.
